_source: Written from Dataset/SYN_README_answer_key.md on 13 Oct 2026, BEFORE any held-out review ran. Not to be edited after seeing results (that would turn the held-out set into a tuning set); any later change must be logged in 'changes' with the reason.
_grading: Verdict: the answer key's red rows (do not sign / conflict / breach) map to HOLD, like EV-01/02/05/06; amber (own paper unfair, AtliQ fixes it before sending) maps to SIGN AFTER CHANGES, like EV-10/13; green to SIGN. mustCite: a blocker/high finding must cite (or be keyed on) that signed contract: the register conflict, graded by evidence rather than by the model's choice of clause type. mustFind: finding-key prefixes as in eval/cases.json ('a|b' = either). mustNotCite / mustNotFlag: no medium-or-higher finding citing / matching it.

cases.why: Pillarstone is a pharma C&F agent / super-stockist: a Competing Business under Kestrel §12 (live to 2028-11-03, binds affiliates). Draft also one-sided: LD 1%/wk to 15%, 60-day payment, uncapped vendor liability, 15-day termination paying accepted milestones only.
$68 Sr DE is below Meridale's $80 MFN (S02 §6.3, worldwide, affiliates: retroactive refund) and below the Crestline MFN ($85, original register). Cobalt adds its own MFN, a third constraint.
SOW deploys IngestIQ, assigned to Novaterra (S03 §6.1-6.2); draft §4.3 warrants AtliQ owns it, uncapped.
Quanta Lake is named in Zephyr Sch 1; Zephyr §7 binds affiliates (Inc signing doesn't help); India + Singapore overlap the Zephyr Territory. Entity question: Inc for an India/ME territory.

§6 puts a Limited Data Set in front of the Pune team; BAA §4.3 bans offshore access including LDS, §4.2 treats affiliates as subcontractors needing approval + own BAA; only the Privacy Officer can approve (§10.3). Insurance: $3M required, AtliQ holds $1M.
Cargoline is #1 on Falconridge Sch 4 (customer non-solicit across the GCC to 2029-09-14, LD $56k; draft §8.1 rep false). Entity mismatch: AtliQ Inc for a Bahrain client, payment to a US account.

AtliQ's own vendor template still has the clauses removed for PixelCraft: 1%/day uncapped penalty, 60-day / pay-when-paid, uncapped vendor liability vs AtliQ's 1-month cap, 24-month non-compete on a 6-person firm, one-way 7-day termination. Separately the Tessellate take-or-pay minimum (S07): hours sent to Monsoon don't count; ~$15k shortfall due Nov 2026.
(1) Lumen cooling-off (S08 §10.2): no EWS for an RBI-regulated lender until 2028-08-12; waiver window already blown. (2) Zephyr ROFR (S04 §8) on India BFSI deals > $50k, not notified.

Notice gives < 30 days (DPA A2.4); SyncRiver moves data to the US (A2.3 needs consent); Kriti not under contract; rates +8% against the initial-term rate freeze (MSA §3.2); §6.1 'SOW prevails' tries to override the MSA.
False-positive test: looks like a Halvorsen conflict but the §8 standstill expired 2026-08-10 and Greystone is a TPA, not a P&C insurer. Terms balanced.

register._why: Answer key 'Obligation register' table: what each signed SYN contract commits AtliQ to. types = acceptable register types for the main commitment; end = live-until date where the key gives one; expired = must be expired on 2026-09-28; affiliates = binds both AtliQ entities.
